def solve(text):
    bal = rej = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        p = line.split()
        if len(p) != 2 or p[0] not in ('deposit', 'withdraw') or not p[1].isdigit() or int(p[1]) <= 0:
            rej += 1; continue
        n = int(p[1])
        if p[0] == 'deposit': bal += n
        elif n <= bal: bal -= n
        else: rej += 1
    return f'{bal} {rej}'
